source.text: ה֧וֹי חֹֽשְׁבֵי־אָ֛וֶן וּפֹ֥עֲלֵי רָ֖ע עַל־מִשְׁכְּבוֹתָ֑ם בְּא֤וֹר הַבֹּ֨קֶר֙ יַעֲשׂ֔וּהָ כִּ֥י יֶשׁ־לְאֵ֖ל יָדָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Woe [to those] planning iniquity and doing evil on their beds; at [the] light of the morning they do it, for it is in [the] power of their hand.

en.L: Woe, [those who] plan iniquity and work evil on their beds! \q In the light of the morning they do it, \q for it is in the power of their hand.
en.B: Woe to those who plot wickedness and lie on their beds working out evil! \q When morning dawns they carry it out, \q because they have the power to do it.
en.R: How terrible it will be for those who lie in bed planning wicked and cruel things! \q As soon as morning comes, they do them, \q because they have the power to do it.

es.L: ¡Ay de los que planean iniquidad y obran el mal en sus camas! \q A la luz de la mañana lo ejecutan, \q porque está en el poder de su mano.
es.B: ¡Ay de los que traman maldad y, acostados en sus camas, planean el mal! \q Al amanecer lo llevan a cabo, \q porque tienen el poder de hacerlo.
es.R: ¡Qué terrible será para los que se acuestan en la cama planeando cosas malvadas y crueles! \q En cuanto amanece, las hacen, \q porque tienen el poder para hacerlo.

fr.L: Malheur, [ceux qui] projettent l’iniquité et trament le mal sur leurs lits ! \q À la lumière du matin ils l’exécutent, \q car c’est au pouvoir de leur main.
fr.B: Malheur à ceux qui méditent la méchanceté et qui, couchés sur leur lit, préparent le mal ! \q Dès que le matin se lève, ils le mettent en œuvre, \q parce qu’ils en ont le pouvoir.
fr.R: Quel malheur pour ceux qui, couchés dans leur lit, préparent des projets méchants et cruels ! \q Dès que le matin arrive, ils les réalisent, \q parce qu’ils ont le pouvoir de le faire.

sw.L: Ole, wale wanaopanga uovu na kutenda mabaya vitandani mwao! \q Katika mwanga wa asubuhi wanayatenda, \q kwa maana [yamo] katika uwezo wa mkono wao.
sw.B: Ole wao wanaopanga maovu, wakilala vitandani mwao wakibuni mabaya! \q Kunapopambazuka wanayatekeleza, \q kwa sababu wana uwezo wa kuyafanya.
sw.R: Itakuwa vibaya sana kwa wale wanaolala vitandani wakipanga mambo maovu na ya kikatili! \q Mara asubuhi inapofika, wanayafanya, \q kwa sababu wana uwezo wa kuyafanya.

vi.L: Khốn cho [những kẻ] mưu toan điều gian ác và làm điều ác trên giường mình! \q Vừa sáng ra, chúng liền thực hiện, \q vì việc ấy ở trong quyền của tay chúng.
vi.B: Khốn cho những kẻ mưu đồ gian ác, nằm trên giường mà tính chuyện ác! \q Trời vừa sáng, chúng liền ra tay thực hiện, \q vì chúng có quyền làm điều ấy.
vi.R: Thật khốn khổ cho những kẻ nằm trên giường mà tính kế làm điều gian ác, độc ác! \q Vừa sáng ra, chúng liền làm ngay, \q vì chúng có quyền lực để làm.

ko.L: 화가 있다, 자기 침상 위에서 죄악을 꾀하고 악을 꾸미는 자들에게! \q 아침 햇빛이 밝으면 그들은 그것을 행한다. \q 그것이 그들의 손에 힘이 있기 때문이다.
ko.B: 침상에 누워 죄악을 꾀하고 악을 꾸미는 자들에게 화가 있다! \q 아침이 밝으면 그들은 그것을 실행한다. \q 그들에게 그럴 힘이 있기 때문이다.
ko.R: 침대에 누워 악하고 잔인한 일을 꾸미는 사람들에게 끔찍한 일이 닥칠 것이다! \q 그들은 아침이 되자마자 그 일을 저지른다. \q 그들에게 그럴 힘이 있기 때문이다.

pt.L: Ai dos que planejam iniquidade e tramam o mal nos seus leitos! \q Na luz da manhã eles o executam, \q porque está no poder da mão deles.
pt.B: Ai dos que tramam maldade e ficam deitados na cama arquitetando o mal! \q Quando amanhece, eles o põem em prática, \q porque têm poder para isso.
pt.R: Que desgraça vai cair sobre os que ficam deitados na cama planejando coisas más e cruéis! \q Assim que amanhece, eles as fazem, \q porque têm o poder de fazê-las.

decisions.choice: Woe: the cry of mourning for the dead, turned into a warning
decisions.reason: The word was cried out at funerals (1 Kings 13:30; Jeremiah 22:18). Spoken over the living, it says that they are as good as dead: judgment is coming on them. Isaiah 5:8 begins a woe on the same sin, joining house to house and field to field.

decisions.choice: plan iniquity ... on their beds: they lie awake scheming
decisions.reason: The bed is where a person thinks at night (Psalm 4:5; 36:5). These people spend the night planning how to take what belongs to others, and act as soon as it is light. The verb "plan" comes back in verse 3: the LORD too is planning, against them.

decisions.choice: it is in the power of their hand: they are able to do it, so they do
decisions.reason: The same phrase is used in Genesis 31:29 and Proverbs 3:27. Their only rule is what they have the power to do. Nothing stops them: they are the rich and the officials.

decisions.choice: Woe, [those who] (L); Woe to (B); How terrible it will be for (R); iniquity (L); wickedness (B); wicked and cruel things (R)
decisions.reason: The cry follows the wording set for the prophets' woes (Isaiah 5:8). Readable joins the two nouns, iniquity and evil, into one phrase.

decisions.choice: "¡Ay de ...!" (L, B); "¡Qué terrible será para ...!" (R)
decisions.reason: The settled Spanish for hoy in the prophets (Isaiah; term sheet).

decisions.choice: hoy: "Malheur, ..." (L), "Malheur à ..." (B), "Quel malheur pour ... !" (R), as the term sheet
decisions.reason: The formula published Isaiah uses; the English meaning decision explains the funeral cry.

decisions.choice: "Ole, ..." (L); "Ole wao ..." (B); "Itakuwa vibaya sana kwa ..." (R)
decisions.reason: Hoy as in Isaiah and the term sheet (as Luke 6:24); recorded once for Micah and Nahum.

decisions.choice: "Khốn cho" (L, B); "Thật khốn khổ cho" (R) for "hoy"
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording for "hoy" as a threat; the meaning decision says it is a mourning cry turned into a warning, which "khốn cho" carries. The evildoers are "chúng", as the terms note gives for the guilty in the oracles.

decisions.choice: *hoy*: "화가 있다" (L, B); "끔찍한 일이 닥칠 것이다" (R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheets [Mt 23:13 L, R]: the mourning cry turned into a warning (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: Ai dos que (L, B); Que desgraça vai cair sobre os que (R)
decisions.reason: The cry of woe (m1) keeps the Portuguese wording of Isaiah 5:8 at each level.

source.text: וְחָמְד֤וּ שָׂדוֹת֙ וְגָזָ֔לוּ וּבָתִּ֖ים וְנָשָׂ֑אוּ וְעָֽשְׁקוּ֙ גֶּ֣בֶר וּבֵית֔וֹ וְאִ֖ישׁ וְנַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And they covet fields and seize [them], and houses and take [them]; and they oppress a man and his house, and a man and his inheritance.

en.L: And they covet fields and seize [them], \q and houses, and carry [them] off; \q and they oppress a man and his house, \q a man and his inheritance.
en.B: They covet fields and seize them, \q houses, and take them away. \q They crush a man and his household, \q a man and his inheritance.
en.R: They want fields, so they grab them. \q They want houses, so they take them. \q They cheat people out of their homes \q and steal the land their families have always owned.

es.L: Y codician campos y [los] arrebatan, \q y casas, y [las] toman; \q y oprimen al hombre y a su casa, \q al hombre y a su heredad.
es.B: Codician campos y se apoderan de ellos, \q y casas, y se las llevan. \q Aplastan al hombre y a su familia, \q al hombre y a su heredad.
es.R: Quieren campos, y los agarran. \q Quieren casas, y se las quedan. \q Les quitan sus casas a la gente con engaños \q y les roban la tierra que su familia siempre ha tenido.

fr.L: Et ils convoitent des champs et [s’en] emparent, \q et des maisons, et [les] enlèvent ; \q et ils oppriment un homme et sa maison, \q un homme et son héritage.
fr.B: Ils convoitent des champs et s’en emparent, \q des maisons, et ils les prennent. \q Ils écrasent un homme et sa famille, \q un homme et son héritage.
fr.R: Ils veulent des champs, alors ils les saisissent. \q Ils veulent des maisons, alors ils les prennent. \q Ils volent aux gens leur maison \q et la terre que leur famille a toujours possédée.

sw.L: Nao wanatamani mashamba na kuyanyang'anya, \q na nyumba, na kuzichukua; \q nao wanamdhulumu mtu na nyumba yake, \q mtu na urithi wake.
sw.B: Wanatamani mashamba na kuyanyakua, \q nyumba, na kuzichukua. \q Wanamkandamiza mtu pamoja na jamaa yake, \q mtu pamoja na urithi wake.
sw.R: Wanataka mashamba, kwa hiyo wanayanyakua. \q Wanataka nyumba, kwa hiyo wanazichukua. \q Wanawadanganya watu na kuwanyang'anya nyumba zao, \q na kuiba ardhi ambayo familia zao zimekuwa nayo tangu zamani.

vi.L: Chúng tham muốn ruộng đất thì chiếm đoạt, \q thèm nhà cửa thì cướp lấy; \q chúng áp bức một người và nhà người ấy, \q một người và cơ nghiệp người ấy.
vi.B: Chúng thèm muốn ruộng đất thì chiếm đoạt, \q nhà cửa thì cướp đi. \q Chúng đè bẹp một người cùng cả gia đình người ấy, \q một người cùng cơ nghiệp người ấy.
vi.R: Chúng muốn có ruộng thì giành lấy. \q Chúng muốn có nhà thì cướp đi. \q Chúng lừa gạt để chiếm nhà của người ta \q và cướp đất mà gia đình họ đã giữ từ bao đời.

ko.L: 그들은 밭들을 탐내어 빼앗고, \q 집들을 [탐내어] 차지한다. \q 그들은 사람과 그의 집을, \q 사람과 그의 유산을 억압한다.
ko.B: 그들은 밭을 탐내어 빼앗고, \q 집을 탐내어 가로챈다. \q 그들은 가장과 그 집안을 짓밟고, \q 사람에게서 그 유산을 빼앗는다.
ko.R: 그들은 밭이 탐나면 빼앗아 버린다. \q 집이 탐나면 차지해 버린다. \q 그들은 사람들을 속여 집을 빼앗고, \q 그 집안이 대대로 물려받은 땅을 가로챈다.

pt.L: E cobiçam campos e [os] tomam à força, \q e casas, e [as] levam; \q e oprimem o homem e a sua casa, \q o homem e a sua herança.
pt.B: Cobiçam campos e os tomam à força, \q e casas, e as levam embora. \q Esmagam o homem e a sua família, \q o homem e a sua herança.
pt.R: Querem campos e por isso os agarram. \q Querem casas e por isso as tomam. \q Enganam as pessoas e ficam com as casas delas \q e roubam a terra que sempre pertenceu às suas famílias.

decisions.choice: covet fields ... houses: they break the last of the Ten Commandments
decisions.reason: The commandment says: "You shall not covet your neighbor's house" and, in Deuteronomy, "his field" (Exodus 20:17; Deuteronomy 5:21). These people do more than covet; they seize. Ahab's taking of Naboth's vineyard is the classic case (1 Kings 21).

decisions.choice: his inheritance: the family's share of the land, given by God
decisions.reason: In Israel the land belonged to the LORD and was shared out among the families as their lasting inheritance (Leviticus 25:23; Numbers 26:52-56). It was not to be sold for good; Naboth would not give up "the inheritance of my fathers" even to a king (1 Kings 21:3). To take a family's land was to take its living and its place among God's people.

decisions.choice: a man: the head of a household, who held its land
decisions.reason: The two words for "man" name the head of a family, through whom the land passed. When he is cheated, his whole household loses its home and its living.

decisions.choice: a man and his house (L); a man and his household (B); people ... their families (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "a man", the head of the household in whose name the land was held (m3), without a gender setting, since the point is the head of a family. Readable says what the loss meant for the whole family.

decisions.choice: "cơ nghiệp" for "inheritance"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: the family's share of the land, given by God; "cơ nghiệp" is the word for an inherited estate and is used for the land of Israel in the published histories.

decisions.choice: "탐내다" for "covet", the verb of the tenth commandment; "유산" (L, B), "대대로 물려받은 땅" (R)
decisions.reason: They break the last of the Ten Commandments (meaning decision), so Korean keeps its verb [Exod 20:17]. The inheritance is the family's land given by God; Readable says so.

source.text: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנְנִ֥י חֹשֵׁ֛ב עַל־הַמִּשְׁפָּחָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את רָעָ֑ה אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹֽא־תָמִ֨ישׁוּ מִשָּׁ֜ם צַוְּארֹֽתֵיכֶ֗ם וְלֹ֤א תֵֽלְכוּ֙ רוֹמָ֔ה כִּ֛י עֵ֥ת רָעָ֖ה הִֽיא׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore thus says Yahweh: Look, I [am] planning against this clan disaster, from which you will not remove your necks, and you will not walk haughtily, for an evil time it [will be].

en.L: Therefore thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: \q Look, I am planning disaster against this clan, \q from which you will not remove your necks, and you will not walk haughtily, \q for it [will be] an evil time.
en.B: Therefore {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says this: \q See, I am planning disaster against this clan, \q a yoke you cannot free your necks from; you will no longer walk proudly, \q for it will be a time of disaster.
en.R: So this is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: \q I am planning to bring disaster on these people. \q You will not be able to escape it, and you will not walk around proudly anymore, \q because it will be a terrible time.

es.L: Por tanto, así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q He aquí, yo planeo contra esta familia un mal \q del cual no {{plural_you:sacarán|sacaréis}} {{plural_you:sus cuellos|vuestros cuellos}}, ni {{plural_you:andarán|andaréis}} erguidos, \q porque [será] un tiempo malo.
es.B: Por eso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: \q {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, estoy planeando un desastre contra esta familia, \q un yugo del que no {{plural_you:podrán sacar el cuello|podréis sacar vuestro cuello}}; ya no {{plural_you:andarán|andaréis}} con altivez, \q porque será un tiempo de desastre.
es.R: Por eso, esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q Voy a traer un desastre sobre este pueblo. \q No {{plural_you:podrán|podréis}} escapar de él, y ya no {{plural_you:andarán|andaréis}} con orgullo, \q porque será un tiempo terrible.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q Voici, je projette contre cette famille un malheur \q dont vous ne retirerez pas vos cous, et vous ne marcherez pas la tête haute, \q car ce [sera] un temps mauvais.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : \q Voici, je projette un malheur contre cette famille, \q un joug dont vous ne pourrez pas dégager votre cou ; vous ne marcherez plus avec arrogance, \q car ce sera un temps de malheur.
fr.R: Alors voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q Je prépare un malheur contre ces gens. \q Vous ne pourrez pas y échapper, et vous ne marcherez plus fièrement, \q car ce sera un temps terrible.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: \q Tazama, ninapanga mabaya juu ya ukoo huu, \q ambayo hamtaziondoa shingo zenu kutoka kwayo, wala hamtatembea kwa kiburi, \q kwa maana [utakuwa] wakati mbaya.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: \q Tazama, ninapanga maafa dhidi ya ukoo huu, \q nira ambayo hamtaweza kuziondoa shingo zenu ndani yake; hamtatembea tena kwa kiburi, \q kwa maana utakuwa wakati wa maafa.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: \q Ninapanga kuleta maafa juu ya watu hawa. \q Hamtaweza kuyaepuka, wala hamtatembea tena kwa kiburi, \q kwa sababu utakuwa wakati mbaya sana.

vi.L: Vì vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: \q Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đang mưu tính tai họa nghịch cùng gia tộc này, \q là điều các ngươi không thể rút cổ mình ra khỏi, và các ngươi sẽ không còn bước đi ngạo mạn, \q vì đó [sẽ là] một thời kỳ tai ác.
vi.B: Vì vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: \q Này, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đang định giáng tai họa trên gia tộc này, \q như một cái ách các ngươi không thể tháo khỏi cổ; các ngươi sẽ không còn nghênh ngang bước đi nữa, \q vì đó sẽ là thời kỳ tai họa.
vi.R: Vì vậy, đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: \q Ta đang định giáng tai họa trên dân này. \q Các ngươi sẽ không thoát được, và các ngươi sẽ không còn đi lại cách kiêu căng nữa, \q vì đó sẽ là một thời kỳ khủng khiếp.

ko.L: 그러므로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. \q 보라, 내가 이 족속에게 재앙을 꾀하고 있으니, \q 너희가 거기에서 너희 목을 빼내지 못하고 거만하게 걷지 못할 것이다. \q 악한 때가 될 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그러므로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. \q 보아라, 내가 이 족속에게 재앙을 꾀하고 있다. \q 그것은 너희가 목을 빼낼 수 없는 멍에가 될 것이다. 너희는 다시는 거만하게 걷지 못할 것이다. \q 재앙의 때가 될 것이기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그래서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. \q 내가 이 백성에게 재앙을 내리려고 계획하고 있다. \q 너희는 그 재앙을 피하지 못할 것이고, 더 이상 뽐내며 다니지 못할 것이다. \q 끔찍한 때가 될 것이기 때문이다.

pt.L: Por isso, assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: \q Eis que eu estou planejando contra este clã uma desgraça, \q da qual vocês não tirarão o pescoço, e não andarão altivos, \q pois será um tempo mau.
pt.B: Por isso, assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: \q Vejam, estou planejando uma desgraça contra este clã, \q um jugo do qual vocês não poderão livrar o pescoço; vocês não andarão mais de cabeça erguida, \q pois será um tempo de desgraça.
pt.R: Por isso, é isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz: \q Estou planejando trazer uma desgraça sobre este povo. \q Vocês não vão conseguir escapar dela, nem vão mais andar por aí cheios de orgulho, \q porque será um tempo terrível.

decisions.choice: I am planning disaster: the LORD answers their planning with his own
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used of the schemers in verse 1. They plan evil against their neighbors; the LORD plans disaster against them. The word for disaster is the word for evil, as in 1:12. The punishment fits the crime.

decisions.choice: this clan: the whole people, spoken of as one family
decisions.reason: The word means an extended family or clan. Amos uses it of all Israel, "the whole clan that I brought up from Egypt" (Amos 3:1). The schemers belong to it, and the whole people will share the judgment.

decisions.choice: you will not remove your necks: the disaster is a yoke they cannot slip
decisions.reason: The picture is of an ox under a yoke, which it cannot pull its neck out of. Those who walked proudly, with heads high (Isaiah 3:16), will be bowed under it. "It will be an evil time" is the same phrase as Amos 5:13.

decisions.choice: Therefore thus says the LORD (L); Therefore the LORD says this (B); So this is what the LORD says (R); a yoke you cannot free your necks from (B); escape it (R)
decisions.reason: The formula follows the wording set for the prophets. Balanced names the yoke that the picture implies (m3); Readable gives its meaning.

decisions.choice: "Así dice el SEÑOR:" (L); "el SEÑOR dice esto:" (B); "esto es lo que dice el SEÑOR:" (R), with no quotation marks around God's words
decisions.reason: The prophetic formula and oracle punctuation settled for the prophets in Spanish. The book-wide choice is recorded here, at its first use in Micah.

decisions.choice: "Ainsi parle le SEIGNEUR :" (L), "Le SEIGNEUR dit ceci :" (B), "Voici ce que dit le SEIGNEUR :" (R), with no quotation marks around God's words, as the term sheet
decisions.reason: The prophetic formula as published Isaiah and Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: "projette" here as for the plotters in 2:1
decisions.reason: The LORD answers their planning with his own, as the English meaning decision notes, so Literal and Balanced use the same verb.

decisions.choice: "Kwa hiyo BWANA asema hivi:" (L); "Kwa hiyo hivi ndivyo BWANA asemavyo:" (B); "Kwa hiyo hili ndilo BWANA analosema:" (R)
decisions.reason: "Thus says the LORD" as in 2 Kings 19:6, Isaiah and Jeremiah, with "Kwa hiyo" for "therefore" (term sheet). God's words after it take no quotation marks.

decisions.choice: "CHÚA phán thế này:" (L); "CHÚA phán như vầy:" (B); "đây là lời CHÚA phán:" (R)
decisions.reason: The Isaiah and Jeremiah note's wording of "Thus says the LORD", followed by a colon and no quotation marks.

decisions.choice: "mưu tính" / "định" for the LORD's planning, against "mưu toan" / "tính kế" for the oppressors in 2:1
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: the LORD answers their planning with his own; the Hebrew uses the same verb, and Literal keeps the same root "mưu" so the answer can be heard.

decisions.choice: "Thus says the LORD": "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다" (L); "이렇게 말씀하신다" (B); "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다" (R), ending in a period
decisions.reason: The formula as the term sheets set it; it keeps the honorific 께서 and ends in a period rather than the English colon. God's words that follow are 해라체 with no quotation marks.

decisions.choice: plural_you on every "you" spoken to the people
decisions.reason: The Hebrew addresses the people in the plural, so every pronoun, verb and possessive takes the plural_you setting.

decisions.choice: "꾀하다" for God's planning, as for theirs in 2:1
decisions.reason: The LORD answers their planning with his own (meaning decision); Literal and Balanced use one verb for both.

source.text: בַּיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא יִשָּׂ֧א עֲלֵיכֶ֣ם מָשָׁ֗ל וְנָהָ֨ה נְהִ֤י נִֽהְיָה֙ אָמַר֙ שָׁד֣וֹד נְשַׁדֻּ֔נוּ חֵ֥לֶק עַמִּ֖י יָמִ֑יר אֵ֚יךְ יָמִ֣ישׁ לִ֔י לְשׁוֹבֵ֥ב שָׂדֵ֖ינוּ יְחַלֵּֽק׃

records.literal_gloss: On that day one will lift up against you a taunt, and he will wail a wailing; it is done, he will say, utterly we are ruined; [the] portion of my people he changes; how he removes [it] from me! To an apostate our fields he divides.

en.L: On that day someone will take up a taunt against you and wail a bitter wailing, and say, "We are utterly ruined! \q He changes the portion of my people; \q how {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} takes [it] away from me! \q To a rebel {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} divides up our fields."
en.B: On that day people will sing a taunt song about you and wail in bitter lament, "We are completely ruined! \q He hands over my people's share to others. \q How {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} takes it away from me! \q He parcels out our fields to a traitor."
en.R: On that day people will make fun of you with a sad song. They will say, "We are completely ruined! \q He has given away my people's land. \q He has taken it from me! \q He gives our fields to traitors!"

es.L: En aquel día se levantará contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} un refrán de burla, y se lamentará con amargo lamento, y dirá: «¡Del todo estamos arruinados! \q Cambia la porción de mi pueblo; \q ¡cómo me [la] quita! \q A un rebelde reparte nuestros campos».
es.B: Aquel día cantarán contra {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} una canción de burla y se lamentarán con amargo llanto: «¡Estamos completamente arruinados! \q Entrega a otros la porción de mi pueblo. \q ¡Cómo me la quita! \q Reparte nuestros campos a un traidor».
es.R: En ese día la gente se burlará de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} con una canción triste. Dirán: «¡Estamos completamente arruinados! \q Ha regalado la tierra de mi pueblo. \q ¡Me la ha quitado! \q ¡Les da nuestros campos a los traidores!».

fr.L: En ce jour-là, on prononcera contre vous un dicton moqueur, et on se lamentera d’une lamentation amère, et on dira : « Nous sommes entièrement dévastés ! \q Il change la part de mon peuple ; \q comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} me [l’]enlève ! \q À un rebelle {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} partage nos champs. »
fr.B: Ce jour-là, on chantera sur vous une chanson moqueuse, et on se lamentera amèrement : « Nous sommes complètement ruinés ! \q Il livre à d’autres la part de mon peuple. \q Comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} me l’enlève ! \q Il distribue nos champs à un traître. »
fr.R: Ce jour-là, on se moquera de vous avec une chanson triste. On dira : « Nous sommes complètement ruinés ! \q Il a donné à d’autres la terre de mon peuple. \q Il me l’a prise ! \q Il donne nos champs à des traîtres ! »

sw.L: Katika siku ile mtu atainua mithali juu yenu, na kuomboleza maombolezo ya uchungu, na kusema, "Tumeangamizwa kabisa! \q Analibadilisha fungu la watu wangu; \q jinsi anavyoliondoa kwangu! \q Kwa mwasi anayagawa mashamba yetu."
sw.B: Siku hiyo watu watawatungia wimbo wa dhihaka na kuomboleza kwa maombolezo ya uchungu, "Tumeangamizwa kabisa! \q Analipeleka fungu la watu wangu kwa wengine. \q Jinsi anavyoliondoa kwangu! \q Anawagawia wasaliti mashamba yetu."
sw.R: Wakati huo watu watawadhihaki kwa wimbo wa huzuni. Watasema, "Tumeangamizwa kabisa! \q Ameitoa ardhi ya watu wangu. \q Ameichukua kutoka kwangu! \q Anawapa wasaliti mashamba yetu!"

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy, người ta sẽ cất lời chế nhạo các ngươi và than vãn một lời than đắng cay, rằng: "Chúng ta bị tàn hại hoàn toàn! \q Ngài đổi phần sản nghiệp của dân tôi; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cất [nó] khỏi tôi biết bao! \q Ngài chia ruộng đất của chúng ta cho kẻ phản bội."
vi.B: Trong ngày ấy, người ta sẽ hát một bài chế nhạo các ngươi và than khóc thảm thiết: "Chúng ta hoàn toàn bị hủy hoại rồi! \q Ngài trao phần sản nghiệp của dân tôi cho kẻ khác. \q Ngài lấy đi khỏi tôi rồi! \q Ngài chia ruộng đất của chúng ta cho kẻ phản bội."
vi.R: Vào ngày ấy, người ta sẽ chế giễu các ngươi bằng một bài ca buồn. Họ sẽ nói: "Chúng ta hoàn toàn tiêu tan rồi! \q Ngài đã cho người khác đất đai của dân tôi. \q Ngài đã lấy đất khỏi tôi! \q Ngài trao ruộng chúng ta cho bọn phản bội!"

ko.L: 그날에 어떤 이가 너희를 두고 조롱의 노래를 부르고, 슬피 통곡하며 말할 것이다. "우리가 완전히 망했다! \q 그분께서 내 백성의 몫을 바꾸신다. \q 어찌 그분께서 그것을 내게서 빼앗으시는가! \q 반역자에게 그분께서 우리 밭들을 나누어 주신다."
ko.B: 그날에 사람들이 너희를 두고 조롱하는 노래를 부르며 슬피 애곡할 것이다. "우리는 완전히 망했다! \q 그분께서 내 백성의 몫을 남에게 넘기신다. \q 어찌 그분께서 그것을 내게서 빼앗으시는가! \q 그분께서 우리 밭을 배신자에게 나누어 주신다."
ko.R: 그날에 사람들이 슬픈 노래로 너희를 놀릴 것이다. 그들이 말할 것이다. "우리는 완전히 망했다! \q 그분께서 내 백성의 땅을 남에게 주셨다. \q 그분께서 그 땅을 내게서 빼앗으셨다! \q 그분께서 우리 밭을 배신자들에게 주신다!"

pt.L: Naquele dia alguém levantará contra vocês uma sátira e lamentará com lamento amargo, e dirá: "Estamos totalmente arruinados! \q Ele troca a porção do meu povo; \q como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} [a] tira de mim! \q A um rebelde {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} reparte os nossos campos."
pt.B: Naquele dia, cantarão sobre vocês uma canção de zombaria e chorarão em lamento amargo: "Estamos completamente arruinados! \q Ele entrega a outros a parte do meu povo. \q Como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} a tira de mim! \q Ele reparte os nossos campos para um traidor."
pt.R: Naquele dia, as pessoas vão zombar de vocês com uma canção triste. Elas vão dizer: "Estamos completamente arruinados! \q Ele deu a outros a terra do meu povo. \q Ele a tirou de mim! \q Ele dá os nossos campos a traidores!"

decisions.choice: a taunt ... a bitter wailing: the land-grabbers' own lament, sung over them
decisions.reason: The first word means a saying, often a mocking one (Isaiah 14:4; Habakkuk 2:6). The wailing is given in three words that sound almost alike, a lament of sound as well as sense; the third is often read "it is done". The rich will mourn the loss of the fields they took from others (verse 2).

decisions.choice: he changes ... he takes away ... he divides: the one who does it is most likely the LORD
alternatives: the enemy who conquers the land
decisions.reason: The speakers do not name who takes their land. Verse 3 has the LORD planning their disaster, and in the Hebrew Bible he is the one who gives and takes the land; the speakers complain that he has done it. The conqueror who carries out the judgment may also be meant.

decisions.choice: a rebel: a faithless or apostate one, probably the foreign conqueror
decisions.reason: The word means one who turns away, faithless (Jeremiah 3:14, 22). Here it seems to be the enemy, a man with no share in Israel's covenant, who now receives the fields. Those who stole from their neighbors will see their land divided up for a stranger. The reading is not certain, and the ancient translations differ here.

decisions.choice: he (with the deity_pronoun setting where it is not at the start of a sentence)
decisions.reason: Since the one who takes the land is most likely the LORD (m2), the pronouns that are not at the start of a sentence carry the setting that capitalizes pronouns for God; the others are capitalized either way. The words themselves do not name him.

decisions.choice: someone will take up a taunt (L); people will sing a taunt song (B); people will make fun of you with a sad song (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "one will lift up" means anyone, people in general. Balanced and Readable say "people" and Readable joins the taunt and the lament into one picture: the sad song is sung in mockery.

decisions.choice: the verbs "Cambia", "quita", "reparte" with no subject pronoun
decisions.reason: Spanish leaves the subject in the verb, so the one who acts (most likely the LORD) is not named, as in the Hebrew, and no deity_pronoun span is needed.

decisions.choice: "en ce jour-là" (L), "ce jour-là" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet.

decisions.choice: "il" for the one who takes the land carries the deity_pronoun setting where it is not at the start of a sentence, as the English
decisions.reason: The English meaning decision takes the LORD as the subject; the line-initial "Il" that starts a sentence is written plainly, as the style guide says.

decisions.choice: "Ngài" for the one who changes, takes and divides, with the deity_pronoun span where it is not at the start of a sentence
decisions.reason: The meaning footnote: the one who does it is most likely the LORD, so Vietnamese uses the reverent pronoun, as the English uses its deity span. In Readable each "Ngài" starts a sentence and is written plainly.

decisions.choice: "그분께서 … 하신다" for the one who takes the land, with -시-
decisions.reason: The one who does it is most likely the LORD (meaning decision, footnoted); the English marks him with the deity_pronoun setting, which Korean has no span for, so the honorific shows it.

decisions.choice: "Katika siku ile" (L); "Siku hiyo" (B); "Wakati huo" (R)
decisions.reason: "In that day" as in Isaiah and the term sheet; recorded once for Micah.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: The English puts the setting on "he" because the one who takes the land is most likely the LORD. Swahili has no free pronoun here: "he" is the verb prefix ("analibadilisha", "anavyoliondoa"), which takes no capital, so the meaning decision carries the point alone.

source.text: לָכֵן֙ לֹֽא־יִֽהְיֶ֣ה לְךָ֔ מַשְׁלִ֥יךְ חֶ֖בֶל בְּגוֹרָ֑ל בִּקְהַ֖ל יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore not will be to you [one] casting a line by lot in [the] assembly of Yahweh.

en.L: Therefore you will have no one \q casting a measuring line by lot \q in the assembly of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: So you will have no one \q to stretch out a measuring line by lot \q in the assembly of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: So none of you will be left \q to receive a share of the land \q when {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s people divide it up again.

es.L: Por tanto, no tendrás quien \q eche el cordel por suerte \q en la asamblea {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Por eso no tendrás a nadie \q que extienda el cordel de medir por sorteo \q en la asamblea {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Por eso no quedará nadie de los tuyos \q que reciba una parte de la tierra \q cuando el pueblo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} vuelva a repartirla.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi tu n’auras personne \q pour jeter le cordeau au sort \q dans l’assemblée {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Aussi n’auras-tu personne \q pour tendre le cordeau et tirer les parts au sort \q dans l’assemblée {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Alors aucun de vous ne restera \q pour recevoir sa part du pays \q quand le peuple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} le partagera de nouveau.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo hutakuwa na mtu \q atakayetupa kamba ya kupimia kwa kura \q katika kusanyiko la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo hutakuwa na mtu \q wa kunyoosha kamba ya kupimia kwa kura \q katika kusanyiko la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo hakuna hata mmoja wenu atakayebaki \q kupokea fungu la nchi \q wakati watu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} watakapoigawa tena.

vi.L: Vì vậy các ngươi sẽ chẳng có ai \q giăng dây đo bằng cách bắt thăm \q trong hội chúng của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Vì thế các ngươi sẽ không còn ai \q giăng dây đo chia phần bằng cách bắt thăm \q trong hội chúng của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Vì vậy sẽ không còn ai trong các ngươi \q được nhận một phần đất \q khi dân của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} chia đất lại.

ko.L: 그러므로 너에게는 \q 제비를 뽑아 측량줄을 던질 자가 \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 회중 가운데 없을 것이다.
ko.B: 그러므로 너희에게는 \q 제비를 뽑아 측량줄을 칠 사람이 \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 회중 가운데 하나도 없을 것이다.
ko.R: 그러므로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 백성이 \q 땅을 다시 나눌 때에, \q 너희 가운데는 땅을 몫으로 받을 사람이 하나도 남지 않을 것이다.

pt.L: Por isso não terás \q quem lance o cordel de medir por sorte \q na assembleia {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: Por isso não terás ninguém \q para estender o cordel de medir por sorteio \q na assembleia {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Por isso nenhum de vocês vai sobrar \q para receber uma parte da terra \q quando o povo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} a repartir de novo.

decisions.choice: casting a measuring line by lot: sharing out the land among the families
decisions.reason: When Israel first entered the land, it was divided by lot and measured out with a line (Joshua 14:2; 18:8-10; Psalm 16:6). When the LORD's people share out the land again, the land-grabbers will have no descendants to receive a share. Those who took others' inheritance will lose their own.

decisions.choice: the assembly of the LORD: the people of God gathered as a community
decisions.reason: The phrase names Israel gathered before the LORD for worship or decision (Deuteronomy 23:2-9). To have no one in it is to be cut off from the people of God.

decisions.choice: none of you will be left to receive a share of the land ... divide it up again (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says what the measuring line and the lot were for (m1). "You" is singular in the Hebrew, speaking to each of the land-grabbers.

decisions.choice: "tendrás", "los tuyos": singular "tú"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "to you" is singular here, so Spanish uses "tú", following the Hebrew switch from plural to singular.

decisions.choice: "제비를 뽑아 측량줄을 던지다" (L, B); "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 회중"
decisions.reason: Sharing out the land among the families (meaning decision); "회중" is the published word for the assembly of the LORD [Deut 23:2]. Readable says what the custom meant.

decisions.choice: não terás (L, B)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "you" is singular here, speaking to each of the land-grabbers (r-en-1), and the LORD's word to one person takes "tu"; Readable says "nenhum de vocês", as the English Readable speaks to them all.

source.text: אַל־תַּטִּ֖פוּ יַטִּיפ֑וּן לֹֽא־יַטִּ֣פוּ לָאֵ֔לֶּה לֹ֥א יִסַּ֖ג כְּלִמּֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: Do not preach, they preach; not they should preach of these; not will be turned back disgraces.

en.L: "Do not preach," they preach. \q "They should not preach of these things; \q disgrace will not overtake [us]."
en.B: "Stop preaching," they preach. \q "No one should preach about such things. \q Disgrace will not catch up with us."
en.R: "Stop preaching at us!" say these preachers. \q "Do not talk about such things. \q Nothing shameful will happen to us."

es.L: «No {{plural_you:prediquen|prediquéis}}», predican ellos. \q «No se debe predicar de estas cosas; \q la deshonra no [nos] alcanzará».
es.B: «¡{{plural_you:Dejen|Dejad}} de predicar!», predican ellos. \q «Nadie debería predicar sobre esas cosas. \q La deshonra no nos alcanzará».
es.R: «¡{{plural_you:Dejen|Dejad}} de predicarnos!», dicen estos predicadores. \q «No {{plural_you:hablen|habléis}} de esas cosas. \q No nos va a pasar nada vergonzoso».

fr.L: « Ne prêchez pas », prêchent-ils. \q « On ne doit pas prêcher sur ces choses ; \q l’opprobre ne [nous] atteindra pas. »
fr.B: « Arrêtez de prêcher », prêchent-ils. \q « Personne ne devrait prêcher sur de telles choses. \q La honte ne nous rattrapera pas. »
fr.R: « Arrêtez de nous faire des sermons ! » disent ces prédicateurs. \q « Ne parlez pas de ces choses-là. \q Rien de honteux ne nous arrivera. »

sw.L: "Msihubiri," wanahubiri. \q "Wasihubiri juu ya mambo haya; \q aibu haitatupata."
sw.B: "Acheni kuhubiri," wanahubiri. \q "Mtu yeyote asihubiri juu ya mambo kama hayo. \q Aibu haitatufikia."
sw.R: "Acheni kutuhubiria!" wanasema wahubiri hawa. \q "Msizungumze juu ya mambo kama hayo. \q Hakuna jambo la aibu litakalotupata."

vi.L: "Đừng giảng," chúng giảng. \q "Người ta không nên giảng về những điều ấy; \q sự nhục nhã sẽ không theo kịp [chúng ta]."
vi.B: "Thôi đừng giảng nữa," chúng giảng. \q "Không ai được giảng về những chuyện như thế. \q Sự nhục nhã sẽ không đuổi kịp chúng ta đâu."
vi.R: Những kẻ giảng đạo này nói: "Đừng giảng cho chúng tôi nữa! \q Đừng nói về những chuyện như thế. \q Chẳng có gì nhục nhã xảy đến cho chúng tôi đâu."

ko.L: "설교하지 마라" 하고 그들이 설교한다. \q "이런 것들을 두고 설교해서는 안 된다. \q 수치가 [우리를] 따라잡지 않을 것이다."
ko.B: "설교를 그만두어라" 하고 그들이 설교한다. \q "아무도 그런 일을 설교해서는 안 된다. \q 수치가 우리에게 닥치지 않을 것이다."
ko.R: "우리에게 설교하지 마라!" 하고 설교자라는 그들이 말한다. \q "그런 이야기는 하지 마라. \q 우리에게는 아무 부끄러운 일도 일어나지 않을 것이다."

pt.L: "Não preguem", eles pregam. \q "Não se deve pregar sobre estas coisas; \q a vergonha não [nos] alcançará."
pt.B: "Parem de pregar", eles pregam. \q "Ninguém deve pregar sobre essas coisas. \q A vergonha não vai nos alcançar."
pt.R: "Parem de pregar para nós!", dizem esses pregadores. \q "Não falem dessas coisas. \q Nada de vergonhoso vai acontecer conosco."

decisions.choice: preach: literally "drip", a word for prophesying
decisions.reason: The verb means to drip, as rain or honey does, and is used of a prophet's speech that drips or pours out (Amos 7:16; Ezekiel 21:2). Here it may carry scorn: Micah's opponents call his words drivel. It comes five times in verses 6 and 11.

decisions.choice: Do not preach, they preach: Micah quotes those who try to silence him
decisions.reason: The speakers are those who reject Micah's message, probably the prophets who preach peace (3:5) and the people who listen to them. Amos was silenced the same way (Amos 2:12; 7:16). They "preach" against preaching.

decisions.choice: disgrace will not overtake us: the opponents are sure no harm will come
alternatives: if they do not preach of these things, disgrace will not turn back
decisions.reason: The verb may come from a root meaning "overtake" or from one meaning "turn back". Read the first way, the opponents are saying that disgrace will not reach them, as the false prophets say in 3:11. Read the second way, it is Micah's reply: if the prophets keep silent, disgrace will not go away. The Hebrew is short and hard, and both readings are possible.

decisions.choice: preach (all levels); say these preachers (R); Nothing shameful will happen to us (R)
decisions.reason: All three levels say "preach" for the verb, which keeps the repetition (m1); Literal and Balanced follow the Hebrew in having them "preach" against preaching. Readable says who is speaking.

decisions.choice: "predicar" at every level
decisions.reason: One Spanish verb is kept for the Hebrew "drip", used of prophesying, so the play on it can be seen here and in verse 11.

decisions.choice: "prêcher" at every level for the verb "drip", used of prophesying; R "faire des sermons", "prédicateurs"
decisions.reason: The English keeps "preach" and its meaning decision gives the literal sense; French "prêcher" carries the same mocking tone.

decisions.choice: "kuhubiri" at every level
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb is literally "drip", used of prophesying; Swahili uses one plain verb, "kuhubiri", for it here and in 2:11, so the play between Micah and his opponents stays visible, as the English "preach" does.

decisions.choice: "giảng" for the verb "drip", used of prophesying
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: a word for prophesying, used scornfully here; "giảng" keeps the repeated sound of the line ("Đừng giảng," chúng giảng) as the English "preach" does. It returns in 2:11.

decisions.choice: "설교하다" at every level for the verb "drip"
decisions.reason: The verb is a word for prophesying (meaning decision), here used with scorn; Korean keeps one verb through 2:6 and 2:11, as the English "preach", so the play stays visible.

decisions.choice: pregar (verses 6 and 11)
decisions.reason: The verb that means "drip" (m1) is "pregar" at every level, here and in verse 11, as the English says "preach". "Profetizar" would lose the scorn the opponents put into it, and "gotejar" is not said of speech in Portuguese.

source.text: הֶאָמ֣וּר בֵּֽית־יַעֲקֹ֗ב הֲקָצַר֙ ר֣וּחַ יְהוָ֔ה אִם־אֵ֖לֶּה מַעֲלָלָ֑יו הֲל֤וֹא דְבָרַ֨י יֵיטִ֔יבוּ עִ֖ם הַיָּשָׁ֥ר הוֹלֵֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: Is it said, house of Jacob: Is it short, [the] Spirit of Yahweh? Or [are] these his deeds? [Do] not my words do good to the upright [one] walking?

en.L: Should it be said, house of Jacob: "Is the Spirit of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} short? \q Are these {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} deeds?" \q Do not {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words do good \q to the one who walks uprightly?
en.B: Should this be said, house of Jacob? "Has {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} run out of patience? \q Are these the things {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} does?" \q Do {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words not do good \q to the one whose life is upright?
en.R: People of Israel, you say, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} does not lose patience. \q He would never do such things to us." \q But {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words are good \q for those who live as they should.

es.L: ¿Se ha de decir esto, casa de Jacob? «¿Se ha acortado el Espíritu {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}? \q ¿Son estas {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} obras?». \q ¿No hacen bien {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} palabras \q al que camina con rectitud?
es.B: ¿Se debe decir esto, casa de Jacob? «¿Se le ha acabado la paciencia {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}? \q ¿Son estas las cosas que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hace?». \q ¿No hacen bien {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} palabras \q al que vive con rectitud?
es.R: Pueblo de Israel, {{plural_you:ustedes dicen|vosotros decís}}: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no pierde la paciencia. \q Él nunca nos haría tales cosas». \q Pero {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} palabras son buenas \q para los que viven como deben.

fr.L: Faut-il le dire, maison de Jacob : « L’Esprit {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} s’est-il raccourci ? \q Sont-ce là {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} actions ? » \q Mes paroles ne font-elles pas du bien \q à celui qui marche avec droiture ?
fr.B: Peut-on dire cela, maison de Jacob ? « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est-il à bout de patience ? \q Est-ce là ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait ? » \q Mes paroles ne font-elles pas du bien \q à celui dont la vie est droite ?
fr.R: Peuple d’Israël, vous dites : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne perd pas patience. \q Il ne nous ferait jamais une chose pareille. » \q Mais {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} paroles sont bonnes \q pour ceux qui vivent comme il faut.

sw.L: Je, yasemwe hivi, ewe nyumba ya Yakobo: "Je, Roho wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amefupika? \q Je, haya ndiyo matendo {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}?" \q Je, maneno {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} hayamtendei mema \q yeye aendaye kwa unyofu?
sw.B: Je, ndivyo inavyopaswa kusemwa, ewe nyumba ya Yakobo? "Je, uvumilivu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} umekwisha? \q Je, haya ndiyo matendo {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}?" \q Je, maneno {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} hayamtendei mema \q yeye ambaye maisha yake ni ya unyofu?
sw.R: Enyi watu wa Israeli, mnasema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hapotezi uvumilivu. \q Kamwe hangetutendea mambo kama haya." \q Lakini maneno {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} ni mema \q kwa wale wanaoishi ipasavyo.

vi.L: Có nên nói vậy chăng, hỡi nhà Gia-cốp: "Thần Linh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} bị rút ngắn sao? \q Đây có phải là những việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm không?" \q Chẳng phải lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} làm ích \q cho người bước đi ngay thẳng sao?
vi.B: Hỡi nhà Gia-cốp, có nên nói như thế không? "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã hết kiên nhẫn rồi sao? \q Đó có phải là những việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm không?" \q Lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chẳng phải đem lại điều tốt \q cho người sống ngay thẳng sao?
vi.R: Hỡi dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, các ngươi nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không hề mất kiên nhẫn. \q Ngài chẳng bao giờ làm những việc như thế cho chúng ta." \q Nhưng lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đem lại điều tốt \q cho những ai sống ngay thẳng.

ko.L: 야곱의 집아, 이렇게 말해서야 되겠느냐? "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영이 짧아지셨느냐? \q 이것들이 그분의 행위이냐?" \q 내 말들이 정직하게 걷는 자에게 \q 좋은 것을 주지 않느냐?
ko.B: 야곱의 집아, 이런 말을 해서야 되겠느냐? "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 참을성을 잃으셨느냐? \q 이런 일들을 그분께서 하시겠느냐?" \q 내 말이 바르게 사는 사람에게 \q 좋은 것을 주지 않느냐?
ko.R: 이스라엘 백성아, 너희는 말한다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 참을성을 잃지 않으신다. \q 그분께서 우리에게 그런 일을 하실 리가 없다." \q 그러나 내 말은 바르게 사는 사람들에게 \q 좋은 것이다.

pt.L: Deve-se dizer isto, casa de Jacó: "Acaso é curto o Espírito {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}? \q São estas as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} obras?" \q Não fazem bem as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} palavras \q a quem anda retamente?
pt.B: Pode-se dizer isso, casa de Jacó? "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} perdeu a paciência? \q São essas as coisas que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} faz?" \q As {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} palavras não fazem bem \q a quem vive com retidão?
pt.R: Povo de Israel, vocês dizem: "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} não perde a paciência. \q Ele nunca faria essas coisas conosco." \q Mas as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} palavras são boas \q para quem vive como deve.

decisions.choice: Should it be said, house of Jacob: the LORD quotes what his people say
alternatives: O you who are called the house of Jacob
Is the house of Jacob cursed?
decisions.reason: The first word is a form of the verb "say", and its sense is debated. It may ask "Is this what is being said?", introducing the people's questions, or it may mean "you who are called the house of Jacob". Some ancient readings change a letter to get "Is the house of Jacob cursed?" Here it is taken as introducing what the people say.

decisions.choice: Is the Spirit of the LORD short? Has the LORD lost his patience?
decisions.reason: To be "short of spirit" means to be impatient or quick-tempered (Proverbs 14:29); "long of anger" means patient (Exodus 34:6). The people say that the LORD is patient and would not bring the disaster Micah announces. The word may also mean the LORD's Spirit, whose power Micah claims in 3:8.

decisions.choice: Do not my words do good to the one who walks uprightly? The LORD answers
decisions.reason: The LORD's word is good for those who live rightly. If it brings only threats to his people, the fault lies in how they live, as verses 8-9 go on to show. "My words" are the LORD's, spoken through his prophet.

decisions.choice: Is the Spirit of the LORD short? (L); Has the LORD run out of patience? (B); The LORD does not lose patience (R); He would never do such things to us (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew idiom with the capitalized Spirit, as Isaiah capitalizes God's Spirit. Balanced and Readable give the meaning (m2). Readable turns the people's questions into the statements they imply.

decisions.choice: "¿Se ha acortado el Espíritu del SEÑOR?" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture; Balanced and Readable say what it means, that the LORD has run out of patience.

decisions.choice: "Roho wa BWANA", capitalised (L)
decisions.reason: Ruach of the LORD is God's Spirit, written "Roho" with a capital (term sheet). Balanced and Readable give the sense of the idiom, the LORD's patience, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Thần Linh của CHÚA bị rút ngắn sao?" (L); "CHÚA đã hết kiên nhẫn rồi sao?" (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture with the terms note's "Thần Linh" for the Spirit of the LORD; Balanced and Readable give the meaning decision's sense, patience.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영이 짧아지셨느냐?" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew idiom ("short of spirit"), meaning that the LORD has lost his patience (meaning decision); God's Spirit takes -시-, as the term sheet sets. Balanced and Readable say "참을성을 잃다".

source.text: וְאֶתְמ֗וּל עַמִּי֙ לְאוֹיֵ֣ב יְקוֹמֵ֔ם מִמּ֣וּל שַׂלְמָ֔ה אֶ֖דֶר תַּפְשִׁט֑וּן מֵעֹבְרִ֣ים בֶּ֔טַח שׁוּבֵ֖י מִלְחָמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And lately my people as an enemy rises up; from [the] front of a garment [the] robe you strip off from [those] passing by in security, returning from war.

en.L: But lately {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people has risen up as an enemy: \q from the front of the garment you strip the robe \q from those who pass by trustingly, \q who turn away from war.
en.B: But lately {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people have risen up like an enemy. \q You strip the cloak off the tunic \q of those who pass by without a care, \q people who want nothing to do with war.
en.R: But lately {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} own people have acted like an enemy. \q You rip the coats off the backs of travelers \q who pass by thinking they are safe, \q people who want no part in war.

es.L: Pero últimamente {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo se ha levantado como enemigo: \q de encima del vestido {{plural_you:arrancan|arrancáis}} el manto \q a los que pasan confiados, \q que se apartan de la guerra.
es.B: Pero últimamente {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo se ha levantado como un enemigo. \q {{plural_you:Arrancan|Arrancáis}} el manto de encima de la túnica \q a los que pasan sin preocupación, \q gente que no quiere saber nada de la guerra.
es.R: Pero últimamente {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} propio pueblo actúa como un enemigo. \q {{plural_you:Les arrancan|Les arrancáis}} los abrigos a los viajeros \q que pasan pensando que están seguros, \q gente que no quiere tomar parte en la guerra.

fr.L: Mais naguère {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple s’est levé comme un ennemi : \q de devant le vêtement vous arrachez le manteau \q à ceux qui passent en confiance, \q qui se détournent de la guerre.
fr.B: Mais depuis peu, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple s’est dressé comme un ennemi. \q Vous arrachez le manteau de dessus la tunique \q de ceux qui passent sans méfiance, \q de gens qui ne veulent pas de la guerre.
fr.R: Mais depuis peu, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} propre peuple agit comme un ennemi. \q Vous arrachez leur manteau aux voyageurs \q qui passent en se croyant en sécurité, \q à des gens qui ne veulent pas la guerre.

sw.L: Lakini siku hizi watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wameinuka kama adui: \q kutoka mbele ya vazi mnalivua joho \q kutoka kwa wale wanaopita bila wasiwasi, \q wanaogeuka kuacha vita.
sw.B: Lakini siku hizi watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wameinuka kama adui. \q Mnalivua joho kutoka kwenye kanzu \q ya wale wanaopita bila wasiwasi, \q watu wasiotaka kuhusika na vita.
sw.R: Lakini siku hizi watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wenyewe wametenda kama adui. \q Mnawanyang'anya wasafiri makoti yao migongoni \q wanapopita wakidhani wako salama, \q watu wasiotaka kushiriki vita.

vi.L: Nhưng gần đây dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã nổi lên như kẻ thù: \q từ phía trước áo, các ngươi lột lấy áo choàng \q của những người đi qua cách yên tâm, \q là những người tránh xa chiến tranh.
vi.B: Nhưng gần đây dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã nổi lên như kẻ thù. \q Các ngươi lột áo choàng khỏi áo trong \q của những người qua đường vô tư không lo nghĩ, \q những người không muốn dính dáng đến chiến tranh.
vi.R: Nhưng gần đây chính dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã hành động như kẻ thù. \q Các ngươi giật áo khoác khỏi lưng khách qua đường, \q là những người tưởng mình được an toàn, \q những người không muốn tham gia chiến tranh.

ko.L: 그런데 요즈음 내 백성이 원수처럼 일어났다. \q 너희가 옷 앞에서 겉옷을 벗겨 낸다, \q 안심하고 지나가는 자들에게서, \q 전쟁에서 돌아선 자들에게서.
ko.B: 그런데 요즈음 내 백성이 원수처럼 일어섰다. \q 너희는 아무 걱정 없이 지나가는 사람들에게서 \q 속옷 위에 걸친 겉옷을 벗겨 낸다. \q 그들은 전쟁과는 아무 상관 없는 사람들이다.
ko.R: 그런데 요즈음 내 백성이 원수처럼 행동한다. \q 너희는 안전하다고 생각하며 지나가는 나그네들의 \q 등에서 겉옷을 벗겨 간다. \q 그들은 전쟁에 끼고 싶지 않은 사람들이다.

pt.L: E há pouco o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo se levantou como inimigo: \q da frente da veste vocês arrancam o manto \q dos que passam confiantes, \q que se afastam da guerra.
pt.B: Mas ultimamente o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo se levantou como um inimigo. \q Vocês arrancam a capa de cima da túnica \q dos que passam despreocupados, \q gente que não quer saber de guerra.
pt.R: Mas ultimamente o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} próprio povo tem agido como um inimigo. \q Vocês arrancam a capa das costas dos viajantes \q que passam achando que estão seguros, \q gente que não quer tomar parte em guerra nenhuma.

decisions.choice: my people has risen up as an enemy: as the Hebrew text has it
alternatives: you rise up against my people as an enemy
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says that the LORD's own people have become an enemy, and the next line says what they do: they rob peaceful travelers. A small change in the Hebrew letters would give "you rise up against my people as an enemy", which fits the second person that follows. The Hebrew as it stands makes sense and is kept.

decisions.choice: you strip the robe off the garment: they take the outer cloak from those who pass
decisions.reason: The first word is the ordinary garment, the second a fine outer robe or cloak worn over it. The cloak was often a poor man's blanket at night, and the law forbade keeping it overnight as a pledge (Exodus 22:25-26; Amos 2:8). These people take it from travelers who suspect nothing.

decisions.choice: who turn away from war: peaceful people
decisions.reason: The phrase reads "those who turn back from war". It most likely means people averse to war, who want no fighting, and are robbed as if they were enemies. It may also mean soldiers coming home, who think themselves safe now that the fighting is over.

decisions.choice: from the front of the garment ... the robe (L); the cloak off the tunic (B); the coats off the backs (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase; Balanced names the two garments; Readable says what is done. "My people" is the LORD speaking, so it carries the setting for pronouns for God.

source.text: נְשֵׁ֤י עַמִּי֙ תְּגָ֣רְשׁ֔וּן מִבֵּ֖ית תַּֽעֲנֻגֶ֑יהָ מֵעַל֙ עֹֽלָלֶ֔יהָ תִּקְח֥וּ הֲדָרִ֖י לְעוֹלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] women of my people you drive out from [the] house of her delights; from upon her children you take away my splendor forever.

en.L: The women of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people you drive out \q from the house of her delights; \q from her children \q you take away {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} splendor forever.
en.B: You drive the women of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people \q out of the homes they love; \q from their young children \q you take away {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} glory forever.
en.R: You force the women of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people \q out of the homes they love. \q From their children \q you take away forever the honor I gave them.

es.L: A las mujeres de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo {{plural_you:echan|echáis}} \q de la casa de sus delicias; \q de sobre sus niños \q {{plural_you:quitan|quitáis}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} esplendor para siempre.
es.B: {{plural_you:Echan|Echáis}} a las mujeres de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo \q de los hogares que aman; \q a sus niños pequeños \q les {{plural_you:quitan|quitáis}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} gloria para siempre.
es.R: {{plural_you:Obligan|Obligáis}} a las mujeres de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo \q a salir de los hogares que aman. \q A sus hijos \q les {{plural_you:quitan|quitáis}} para siempre la honra que yo les di.

fr.L: Les femmes de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, vous [les] chassez \q de la maison de ses délices ; \q à ses enfants \q vous enlevez {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} splendeur pour toujours.
fr.B: Vous chassez les femmes de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple \q des maisons qu’elles aiment ; \q à leurs jeunes enfants \q vous enlevez {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} gloire pour toujours.
fr.R: Vous forcez les femmes de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple \q à quitter les maisons qu’elles aiment. \q À leurs enfants, \q vous enlevez pour toujours l’honneur que je leur avais donné.

sw.L: Wanawake wa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mnawafukuza \q kutoka nyumba ya furaha yao; \q kutoka kwa watoto wao \q mnaondoa fahari {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} milele.
sw.B: Mnawafukuza wanawake wa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} \q kutoka nyumba wanazozipenda; \q kutoka kwa watoto wao wadogo \q mnaondoa utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} milele.
sw.R: Mnawalazimisha wanawake wa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} \q kutoka nyumba wanazozipenda. \q Kutoka kwa watoto wao \q mnaondoa milele heshima niliyowapa.

vi.L: Các phụ nữ của dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, các ngươi đuổi ra \q khỏi ngôi nhà mà nàng yêu thích; \q khỏi con cái nàng \q các ngươi cất đi vẻ huy hoàng của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mãi mãi.
vi.B: Các ngươi đuổi các phụ nữ của dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} \q ra khỏi ngôi nhà họ yêu dấu; \q khỏi con thơ của họ, \q các ngươi cất mất vinh quang của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mãi mãi.
vi.R: Các ngươi xua đuổi các phụ nữ của dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} \q ra khỏi ngôi nhà họ yêu quý. \q Khỏi con cái họ, \q các ngươi lấy mất mãi mãi danh dự {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã ban cho chúng.

ko.L: 너희가 내 백성의 여자들을 \q 그 여자의 즐거운 집에서 쫓아내고, \q 그 여자의 어린 자녀들에게서 \q 나의 영화를 영원히 빼앗는다.
ko.B: 너희는 내 백성의 여자들을 \q 그들이 아끼는 집에서 쫓아내고, \q 그들의 어린 자녀들에게서 \q 내 영광을 영원히 빼앗는다.
ko.R: 너희는 내 백성의 여자들을 \q 그들이 사랑하는 집에서 내쫓는다. \q 그들의 자녀들에게서 \q 내가 준 명예를 영원히 빼앗는다.

pt.L: As mulheres do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo vocês expulsam \q da casa das delícias dela; \q de cima das crianças dela \q vocês tiram o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} esplendor para sempre.
pt.B: Vocês expulsam as mulheres do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo \q das casas que elas amam; \q dos seus filhos pequenos \q vocês tiram a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} glória para sempre.
pt.R: Vocês obrigam as mulheres do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo \q a sair das casas que elas amam. \q Dos filhos delas \q vocês tiram para sempre a honra que eu dei a eles.

decisions.choice: the women of my people: most likely widows, with no man to defend them
decisions.reason: The law and the prophets name widows and orphans as those the powerful must not exploit (Exodus 22:21-23; Isaiah 10:2). A woman whose husband had died could be pushed out of her home, and her children with her. The text does not say "widows", and it may mean women in general, but the picture is of the defenseless.

decisions.choice: my splendor: the honor the LORD gave his people
decisions.reason: The word means splendor, majesty, honor. The LORD calls it his: the dignity of belonging to his people and living free on his land. When the children are driven out or sold into debt slavery, they lose it, and the LORD counts it as stolen from him. "Forever" means for good, with no hope of return.

decisions.choice: the house of her delights (L); the homes they love (B, R); splendor (L); glory (B); the honor I gave them (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the singular "her" of the Hebrew, which speaks of each woman; Balanced and Readable say "they". Readable says what "my splendor" means (m2).

decisions.choice: "furaha yake", "watoto wake" (L), singular; "wao" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the singular "her" of the Hebrew, which speaks of each woman; Balanced and Readable say "their", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "nàng" for the singular "her" at Literal; "họ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew's switch to the singular, each woman pictured on her own; Balanced and Readable keep the plural, as the English does.

source.text: ק֣וּמוּ וּלְכ֔וּ כִּ֥י לֹא־זֹ֖את הַמְּנוּחָ֑ה בַּעֲב֥וּר טָמְאָ֛ה תְּחַבֵּ֖ל וְחֶ֥בֶל נִמְרָֽץ׃

records.literal_gloss: Arise and go, for not this [is] the resting place; because of uncleanness it will destroy, and destruction [will be] grievous.

en.L: Arise and go, \q for this [is] not the resting place; \q because of uncleanness it will destroy, and [the] destruction [will be] grievous.
en.B: Get up and go! \q This is not the place of rest, \q because uncleanness brings destruction, a painful destruction.
en.R: Get up and leave! \q This land is no longer a place where you can rest. \q You have made it unclean, and it will be completely destroyed.

es.L: {{plural_you:Levántense y váyanse|Levantaos e idos}}, \q porque este no [es] el lugar de reposo; \q a causa de la impureza destruirá, y [la] destrucción [será] dolorosa.
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Levántense y váyanse|Levantaos e idos}}! \q Este no es el lugar de descanso, \q porque la impureza trae destrucción, una destrucción dolorosa.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Levántense y váyanse|Levantaos e idos}}! \q Esta tierra ya no es un lugar donde {{plural_you:puedan|podáis}} descansar. \q {{plural_you:Ustedes la han hecho|Vosotros la habéis hecho}} impura, y será destruida por completo.

fr.L: Levez-vous et allez-vous-en, \q car ce n’[est] pas ici le lieu du repos ; \q à cause de l’impureté, il détruira, et la destruction [sera] douloureuse.
fr.B: Levez-vous, partez ! \q Ce n’est pas ici le lieu du repos, \q car l’impureté amène la destruction, une destruction cruelle.
fr.R: Levez-vous et partez ! \q Ce pays n’est plus un endroit où vous pouvez vivre en paix. \q Vous l’avez rendu impur, et il sera complètement détruit.

sw.L: Inukeni mwende, \q kwa maana hapa si mahali pa kupumzika; \q kwa sababu ya unajisi utaangamiza, nayo maangamizi [yatakuwa] makali.
sw.B: Inukeni, mwende zenu! \q Hapa si mahali pa kupumzika, \q kwa sababu unajisi huleta maangamizi, maangamizi yenye uchungu.
sw.R: Inukeni muondoke! \q Nchi hii si mahali ambapo mnaweza kupumzika tena. \q Mmeifanya kuwa najisi, nayo itaangamizwa kabisa.

vi.L: Hãy chỗi dậy và đi đi, \q vì đây không [phải là] nơi an nghỉ; \q vì sự ô uế, nó sẽ hủy diệt, và [sự] hủy diệt [sẽ] nặng nề.
vi.B: Hãy đứng dậy mà đi! \q Đây không phải là nơi an nghỉ, \q vì sự ô uế đem đến hủy diệt, một sự hủy diệt đau đớn.
vi.R: Hãy đứng dậy mà đi đi! \q Xứ này không còn là nơi các ngươi được nghỉ ngơi nữa. \q Các ngươi đã làm cho nó ra ô uế, và nó sẽ bị hủy diệt hoàn toàn.

ko.L: 일어나서 가거라. \q 이곳은 안식할 곳이 아니다. \q 부정함 때문에 그것이 멸망시킬 것이니, 그 멸망이 참혹할 것이다.
ko.B: 일어나 떠나가거라! \q 이곳은 쉴 곳이 아니다. \q 부정함이 멸망을, 참혹한 멸망을 가져오기 때문이다.
ko.R: 일어나 떠나라! \q 이 땅은 이제 너희가 쉴 수 있는 곳이 아니다. \q 너희가 이 땅을 더럽혔으니, 이 땅은 완전히 망할 것이다.

pt.L: Levantem-se e vão, \q pois este não [é] o lugar de descanso; \q por causa da impureza destruirá, e a destruição [será] dolorosa.
pt.B: Levantem-se e vão embora! \q Este não é o lugar de descanso, \q porque a impureza traz destruição, uma destruição dolorosa.
pt.R: Levantem-se e saiam daqui! \q Esta terra não é mais um lugar onde vocês podem descansar. \q Vocês a deixaram impura, e ela vai ser completamente destruída.

decisions.choice: the resting place: the land the LORD gave his people to live in at peace
decisions.reason: Moses called the promised land "the rest and the inheritance" the LORD would give (Deuteronomy 12:9; compare Psalm 95:11). Those who drove others out of their homes (verse 9) will themselves be driven out of the land.

decisions.choice: Arise and go ... because of uncleanness it will destroy: the oppressors are sent into exile
alternatives: the oppressors' words to their victims as they drive them out
for a trifle you take a pledge, a harsh pledge
decisions.reason: Read as the LORD's sentence, the command sends the oppressors out of the land, which their wrongs have made unclean (Leviticus 18:25-28). Some read it as the cruel words the oppressors say to the families they evict. The last line is hard: the verb for destroying is spelled like a verb for taking a pledge, and some read "for a trifle you take a harsh pledge", which fits verses 8-9.

decisions.choice: This land is no longer a place where you can rest; You have made it unclean (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says what the resting place is (m1) and who made it unclean.

source.text: לוּ־אִ֞ישׁ הֹלֵ֥ךְ ר֨וּחַ֙ וָשֶׁ֣קֶר כִּזֵּ֔ב אַטִּ֣ף לְךָ֔ לַיַּ֖יִן וְלַשֵּׁכָ֑ר וְהָיָ֥ה מַטִּ֖יף הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: If a man walking [in] wind and falsehood lied, I will preach to you of wine and of strong drink, and he would be [the] preacher of this people.

en.L: If a man walking [after] wind and falsehood should lie: \q "I will preach to you \q of wine and of strong drink," \q and he would be the preacher of this people!
en.B: If someone came along, full of wind and lies, saying, \q "I will preach to you \q about wine and beer," \q he would be just the preacher for this people!
en.R: If a man came along with empty words and lies \q and said, "I will preach to you \q about wine and beer," \q he would be the kind of preacher these people like!

es.L: Si un hombre que anda [tras] el viento y la mentira mintiera: \q «Te predicaré \q del vino y del licor», \q ¡él sería el predicador de este pueblo!
es.B: Si alguien llegara, lleno de viento y de mentiras, diciendo: \q «Te predicaré \q sobre el vino y la cerveza», \q ¡ese sería justo el predicador para este pueblo!
es.R: Si llegara un hombre con palabras vacías y mentiras \q y dijera: «Te voy a predicar \q sobre el vino y la cerveza», \q ¡ese sería el tipo de predicador que le gusta a esta gente!

fr.L: Si un homme marchant [selon] le vent et le mensonge mentait : \q « Je te prêcherai \q sur le vin et sur la boisson forte », \q il serait le prêcheur de ce peuple !
fr.B: Si quelqu’un arrivait, plein de vent et de mensonges, en disant : \q « Je vais te prêcher \q le vin et la bière », \q ce serait bien le prédicateur qu’il faut à ce peuple !
fr.R: Si un homme arrivait avec des paroles creuses et des mensonges \q et disait : « Je vais te faire des sermons \q sur le vin et la bière », \q il serait le genre de prédicateur que ces gens aiment !

sw.L: Kama mtu aendaye [kufuata] upepo na uongo angedanganya: \q "Nitawahubiria \q juu ya divai na juu ya kileo," \q naye angekuwa mhubiri wa watu hawa!
sw.B: Kama mtu angekuja, aliyejaa upepo na uongo, akisema, \q "Nitawahubiria \q juu ya divai na pombe," \q angekuwa mhubiri hasa wa watu hawa!
sw.R: Kama mtu angekuja na maneno matupu na uongo, \q akasema, "Nitawahubiria \q juu ya divai na pombe," \q angekuwa mhubiri ambaye watu hawa wanampenda!

vi.L: Nếu có người bước theo gió và sự giả dối mà nói dối: \q "Tôi sẽ giảng cho các ngươi \q về rượu và về men say," \q thì hắn sẽ là người giảng cho dân này!
vi.B: Nếu có ai đến, đầy những lời rỗng tuếch và dối trá, mà nói: \q "Tôi sẽ giảng cho các người \q về rượu và bia," \q thì hắn hẳn là người giảng hợp với dân này!
vi.R: Nếu có một người đến với những lời rỗng tuếch và dối trá \q mà nói: "Tôi sẽ giảng cho các người \q về rượu và bia," \q thì hắn chính là loại người giảng mà dân này ưa thích!

ko.L: 어떤 사람이 바람과 거짓을 [따라] 걸으며 속여 말하기를, \q "내가 너에게 \q 포도주와 독주에 대하여 설교하겠다" 하면, \q 그가 바로 이 백성의 설교자가 될 것이다!
ko.B: 누가 바람과 거짓말로 가득하여 와서, \q "내가 너희에게 \q 포도주와 독한 술에 대하여 설교하겠다" 하고 말한다면, \q 그야말로 이 백성에게 딱 맞는 설교자일 것이다!
ko.R: 어떤 사람이 헛된 말과 거짓말을 늘어놓으며 와서 \q "내가 너희에게 \q 포도주와 술에 대하여 설교하겠다" 하고 말한다면, \q 그런 사람이야말로 이 백성이 좋아하는 설교자일 것이다!

pt.L: Se um homem que anda [atrás do] vento e da falsidade mentisse: \q "Eu pregarei para vocês \q sobre o vinho e sobre a bebida forte", \q ele seria o pregador deste povo!
pt.B: Se aparecesse alguém cheio de vento e de mentiras, dizendo: \q "Eu vou pregar para vocês \q sobre vinho e cerveja", \q esse seria o pregador certo para este povo!
pt.R: Se aparecesse um homem com palavras vazias e mentiras \q e dissesse: "Eu vou pregar para vocês \q sobre vinho e cerveja", \q ele seria o tipo de pregador de que este povo gosta!

decisions.choice: walking after wind and falsehood: full of empty words and lies
decisions.reason: The word for wind is also the word for spirit. The false preacher has wind, nothing, where the true prophet has the Spirit of the LORD (2:7; 3:8). Hosea calls the prophet "a man of the spirit" in mockery (Hosea 9:7).

decisions.choice: I will preach to you of wine and strong drink: a message of good times
decisions.reason: The verb is "drip" again (verse 6), and it fits the picture of wine dripping. Such a preacher promises plenty and pleasure, a message the people want to hear. Isaiah describes priests and prophets who reel with wine and strong drink (Isaiah 28:7).

decisions.choice: walking [after] wind and falsehood (L); full of wind and lies (B); with empty words and lies (R); strong drink (L); beer (B, R)
decisions.reason: The drinks follow Isaiah's wording (Isaiah 5:11; 28:7). Readable says what "wind" means (m1).

decisions.choice: "Te predicaré" (singular); "licor" (L); "cerveza" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "to you" is singular, so Spanish uses "te"; "licor" keeps the general "strong drink" at Literal.

decisions.choice: "men say" (L); "bia" (B, R) for "shekar"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the old general word for an intoxicating drink; Balanced and Readable say "bia", as the English does, since barley beer was the common strong drink.

decisions.choice: the false preacher says "các người" to the people
decisions.reason: "Các ngươi" is God's word to the people in rebuke; a man selling them good news would flatter them with the ordinary "các người". Literal keeps "các ngươi" to stay close to the Hebrew line.

source.text: אָסֹ֨ף אֶאֱסֹ֜ף יַעֲקֹ֣ב כֻּלָּ֗ךְ קַבֵּ֤ץ אֲקַבֵּץ֙ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יַ֥חַד אֲשִׂימֶ֖נּוּ כְּצֹ֣אן בָּצְרָ֑ה כְּעֵ֨דֶר֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ הַדָּֽבְר֔וֹ תְּהִימֶ֖נָה מֵאָדָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Gathering I will gather Jacob, all of you; assembling I will assemble [the] remnant of Israel; together I will set them like sheep of a fold, like a flock in [the] midst of its pasture; they will be in uproar from humankind.

en.L: I will surely gather all of you, Jacob; I will surely assemble the remnant of Israel; \q I will put them together like sheep in a fold, \q like a flock in the midst of its pasture; \q they will hum with people.
en.B: I will gather all of you, Jacob; I will surely bring together the remnant of Israel. \q I will put them together like sheep in a pen, \q like a flock in its pasture; \q the place will be loud with people.
en.R: People of Jacob, I will gather all of you. I will bring together the people of Israel who are left. \q I will put them together like sheep in a pen, \q like a flock in its field. \q There will be the noise of many people.

es.L: Ciertamente te reuniré, Jacob, a todos los tuyos; ciertamente juntaré al remanente de Israel; \q los pondré juntos como ovejas en el redil, \q como un rebaño en medio de su pastizal; \q bullirán de gente.
es.B: Te reuniré, Jacob, a todos los tuyos; ciertamente juntaré al remanente de Israel. \q Los pondré juntos como ovejas en un corral, \q como un rebaño en su pastizal; \q el lugar resonará con el bullicio de la gente.
es.R: Pueblo de Jacob, te reuniré por completo. Juntaré a los que queden del pueblo de Israel. \q Los pondré juntos como ovejas en un corral, \q como un rebaño en su campo. \q Habrá ruido de mucha gente.

fr.L: Je rassemblerai, oui, je rassemblerai Jacob tout entier ; je réunirai, oui, je réunirai le reste d’Israël ; \q je les mettrai ensemble comme des brebis dans un enclos, \q comme un troupeau au milieu de son pâturage ; \q ils bourdonneront d’hommes.
fr.B: Je te rassemblerai tout entier, Jacob ; je réunirai sûrement le reste d’Israël. \q Je les mettrai ensemble comme des brebis dans un enclos, \q comme un troupeau dans son pâturage ; \q l’endroit sera bruyant de monde.
fr.R: Peuple de Jacob, je vous rassemblerai tous. Je réunirai les Israélites qui restent. \q Je les mettrai ensemble comme des moutons dans un enclos, \q comme un troupeau dans son champ. \q On entendra le bruit d’une foule nombreuse.

sw.L: Hakika nitakukusanya, Yakobo, wewe wote; hakika nitayakusanya mabaki ya Israeli; \q nitawaweka pamoja kama kondoo zizini, \q kama kundi katikati ya malisho yake; \q watavuma kwa wingi wa watu.
sw.B: Nitawakusanya ninyi nyote, Yakobo; hakika nitayaleta pamoja mabaki ya Israeli. \q Nitawaweka pamoja kama kondoo zizini, \q kama kundi katika malisho yake; \q mahali hapo patajaa kelele za watu.
sw.R: Enyi watu wa Yakobo, nitawakusanya nyote. Nitawaleta pamoja watu wa Israeli waliobaki. \q Nitawaweka pamoja kama kondoo zizini, \q kama kundi katika shamba lake. \q Kutakuwa na kelele za watu wengi.

vi.L: Ta chắc chắn sẽ nhóm hiệp tất cả các ngươi, hỡi Gia-cốp; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chắc chắn sẽ thu góp những người sót lại của Y-sơ-ra-ên; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đặt chúng chung với nhau như chiên trong chuồng, \q như bầy chiên giữa đồng cỏ; \q chúng sẽ ồn ào tiếng người.
vi.B: Hỡi Gia-cốp, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ nhóm hiệp tất cả các ngươi; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chắc chắn sẽ thu góp những người sót lại của Y-sơ-ra-ên. \q Ta sẽ đặt họ chung với nhau như chiên trong chuồng, \q như bầy chiên trong đồng cỏ; \q nơi ấy sẽ rộn ràng tiếng người.
vi.R: Hỡi dân Gia-cốp, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ nhóm hiệp tất cả các ngươi. Ta sẽ tập hợp những người còn sống sót của Y-sơ-ra-ên. \q Ta sẽ đặt họ chung với nhau như chiên trong chuồng, \q như bầy chiên ngoài đồng. \q Sẽ có tiếng ồn ào của rất nhiều người.

ko.L: 야곱아, 내가 반드시 너희를 모두 모으고, 내가 반드시 이스라엘의 남은 자를 불러 모으겠다. \q 내가 그들을 우리 안의 양들처럼, \q 목장 한가운데 있는 양 떼처럼 함께 두겠다. \q 그곳이 사람들로 웅성거릴 것이다.
ko.B: 야곱아, 내가 너희를 모두 모으겠다. 내가 반드시 이스라엘의 남은 사람들을 불러 모으겠다. \q 내가 그들을 우리 안의 양들처럼, \q 목장에 있는 양 떼처럼 함께 두겠다. \q 그곳은 사람들로 시끌벅적할 것이다.
ko.R: 야곱 백성아, 내가 너희를 모두 모으겠다. 이스라엘의 살아남은 사람들을 불러 모으겠다. \q 내가 그들을 우리 안의 양들처럼, \q 들판의 양 떼처럼 함께 모아 두겠다. \q 그곳에 많은 사람들의 소리가 가득할 것이다.

pt.L: Certamente ajuntarei a ti por inteiro, Jacó; certamente reunirei o remanescente de Israel; \q eu os porei juntos como ovelhas no aprisco, \q como um rebanho no meio do seu pasto; \q farão alvoroço de gente.
pt.B: Reunirei todos vocês, Jacó; certamente juntarei o remanescente de Israel. \q Eu os porei juntos como ovelhas no curral, \q como um rebanho no seu pasto; \q o lugar ficará cheio do barulho de gente.
pt.R: Povo de Jacó, vou reunir todos vocês. Vou juntar os que restaram de Israel. \q Vou colocá-los juntos como ovelhas num curral, \q como um rebanho no seu campo. \q Haverá o barulho de muita gente.

decisions.choice: I will surely gather: the LORD's promise to bring his scattered people back
alternatives: the words of the false prophets, promising safety
decisions.reason: After the threats of verses 1-11, the LORD suddenly promises to gather what is left of his people, as a shepherd gathers his sheep (Jeremiah 23:3; Ezekiel 34:12-13). Micah often sets judgment and hope side by side (4:6-7; 5:6-7). Some take verses 12-13 as the kind of comfort the false prophets offered, which Micah quotes to refute, but nothing in the words marks them as quoted.

decisions.choice: the remnant of Israel: those who are left after the judgment
decisions.reason: The remnant is the part of the people that survives disaster and is kept by God. It is a key word in Micah (4:7; 5:6-7; 7:18) and in Isaiah (Isaiah 10:20-22). The promise does not cancel the judgment; it is given to those who come through it.

decisions.choice: a fold: a sheep pen
decisions.reason: The word is spelled like the name of Bozrah, a city of Edom famed for its flocks (Isaiah 34:6), and some ancient translations took it so. A related word means an enclosure, and "a fold" matches "pasture" in the next line.

decisions.choice: I will surely gather (L); I will gather ... I will surely bring together (B); hum with people (L); loud with people (B); the noise of many people (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew doubles each verb for emphasis; Literal says "surely" twice, and Balanced and Readable once or not at all. The last line pictures the noise of a crowd, as of a flock bleating, because there are so many.

decisions.choice: "el remanente de Israel" (L, B); "los que queden" (R)
decisions.reason: The settled Spanish for "remnant" (Isaiah; Romans 9:27).

decisions.choice: the remnant "le reste" (L, B), "ceux qui restent" (R); sheep "brebis" (L, B), "moutons" (R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet for the prophets.

decisions.choice: "ils bourdonneront d'hommes"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew word for humankind in its traditional French form; no gender setting is needed, since the sense is a crowd, not a statement about people in general.

decisions.choice: "mabaki" (L, B); "watu waliobaki" (R)
decisions.reason: Remnant as in Isaiah, Romans 9:27 and the term sheet; recorded once for Micah.

decisions.choice: "những người sót lại" (L, B) / "những người còn sống sót" (R); the remnant are "họ" in this promise at B and R, "chúng" at L where the Hebrew pronoun stays close to the flock image
decisions.reason: The terms note gives "họ" for Israel in promises. Literal "chúng" reads with the sheep of the same line; a reviewer may prefer "họ" there too.

decisions.choice: remnant: "남은 자" (L); "남은 사람들" (B); "살아남은 사람들" (R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheets [Rom 9:27].

decisions.choice: o remanescente de Israel (L, B); os que restaram de Israel (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also 4:7; 5:6-7; 7:18): "o remanescente" at Literal and Balanced, the word set for the prophets in Portuguese (m2); Readable says plainly who they are, as the English Readable does.
