records.literal_gloss: Goes up the breaker before them; they break through and pass through [the] gate and go out by it; and passes on their king before them, and Yahweh at their head.

en.L: The one who breaks through will go up before them; \q they will break through and pass the gate \q and go out by it; \q and their king will pass on before them, \q {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} at their head.
en.B: The one who breaks through will go up ahead of them; \q they will break out, go through the gate, \q and leave by it. \q Their king will go on before them, \q {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} at their head.
en.R: The one who opens the way will go ahead of them. \q They will break out through the gate \q and go free. \q Their king will lead them out. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} will be at their head.

es.L: Subirá delante de ellos el que abre brecha; \q abrirán brecha y pasarán la puerta \q y saldrán por ella; \q y pasará su rey delante de ellos, \q y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} a la cabeza de ellos.
es.B: El que abre brecha subirá delante de ellos; \q ellos abrirán brecha, cruzarán la puerta \q y saldrán por ella. \q Su rey irá delante de ellos, \q {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} a la cabeza.
es.R: El que abre el camino irá delante de ellos. \q Atravesarán la puerta a la fuerza \q y saldrán libres. \q Su rey los guiará hacia fuera. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mismo irá a la cabeza.

fr.L: Celui qui fait la brèche montera devant eux ; \q ils feront la brèche et passeront la porte \q et sortiront par elle ; \q et leur roi passera devant eux, \q {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} à leur tête.
fr.B: Celui qui ouvre la brèche montera devant eux ; \q ils forceront le passage, franchiront la porte \q et sortiront par là. \q Leur roi marchera devant eux, \q {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} à leur tête.
fr.R: Celui qui ouvre le chemin marchera devant eux. \q Ils passeront de force par la porte \q et ils seront libres. \q Leur roi les conduira dehors. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} marchera à leur tête.

sw.L: Yeye avunjaye atapanda mbele yao; \q watavunja na kupita langoni \q na kutoka kupitia hilo; \q na mfalme wao atapita mbele yao, \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kichwani mwao.
sw.B: Yeye avunjaye ataongoza mbele yao; \q watavunja na kupita langoni, \q na kutoka nje. \q Mfalme wao atatangulia mbele yao, \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akiwa kichwani mwao.
sw.R: Yeye anayefungua njia atawatangulia. \q Watavunja na kutoka kupitia lango \q na kuwa huru. \q Mfalme wao atawaongoza kutoka. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} atakuwa mbele yao.

vi.L: Đấng mở đường sẽ đi lên trước họ; \q họ sẽ phá vỡ mà đi qua cổng \q và ra bởi đó; \q vua của họ sẽ đi qua trước họ, \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở đầu họ.
vi.B: Đấng mở đường sẽ đi lên trước họ; \q họ sẽ phá vây, đi qua cổng \q và ra khỏi đó. \q Vua của họ sẽ đi trước họ, \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} dẫn đầu họ.
vi.R: Đấng mở đường sẽ đi trước họ. \q Họ sẽ phá cổng mà ra \q và được tự do. \q Vua của họ sẽ dẫn họ ra. \q Chính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ đi đầu họ.

ko.L: 길을 여는 자가 그들 앞에서 올라가고, \q 그들이 [성벽을] 뚫고 성문을 지나 \q 그리로 나갈 것이다. \q 그들의 왕이 그들 앞에서 지나가고, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들의 맨 앞에 [서실 것이다].
ko.B: 길을 뚫는 이가 그들보다 앞서 올라가고, \q 그들은 뚫고 나가 성문을 지나 \q 그 문으로 나갈 것이다. \q 그들의 왕이 그들 앞에서 나아가시고, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들의 맨 앞에 서실 것이다.
ko.R: 길을 여는 이가 그들보다 앞서 갈 것이다. \q 그들은 성문을 뚫고 나가 \q 자유롭게 될 것이다. \q 그들의 왕이 그들을 이끌고 나가실 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 친히 그들의 맨 앞에 서실 것이다.

pt.L: Aquele que abre brecha subirá diante deles; \q eles abrirão brecha e passarão a porta \q e sairão por ela; \q e o rei deles passará diante deles, \q {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} à frente deles.
pt.B: Aquele que abre caminho subirá à frente deles; \q eles romperão a saída, passarão pela porta \q e sairão por ela. \q O rei deles irá adiante deles, \q {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} à frente deles.
pt.R: Aquele que abre o caminho vai à frente deles. \q Eles vão romper a porta e sair por ela \q e ficar livres. \q O rei deles vai conduzi-los para fora. \q {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} em pessoa vai estar à frente deles.

decisions.choice: the one who breaks through: the leader who breaks open the way out
decisions.reason: The verb is used of breaking through a wall or a hedge, and of the LORD who "broke through" David's enemies at Baal-perazim (2 Samuel 5:20). The flock gathered in the pen (verse 12) breaks out through the gate, led by the one who goes before it.

decisions.choice: their king ... the LORD at their head: the breaker and the king are the LORD himself
alternatives: a human king who leads them, with the LORD above him
decisions.reason: The last two lines are parallel, so "their king" is most likely the LORD, who goes before his people as he did out of Egypt (Exodus 13:21; Isaiah 52:12). Some read the king as a coming ruler from David's line (5:1). The text joins the two closely.

decisions.choice: they break through ... pass ... go out: told as done, though it is still to come
decisions.reason: The verbs are in the form for a completed act, as prophets speak of what is certain. The scene is a new exodus, out of the captivity that verses 3-10 announced.

decisions.choice: go free; will lead them out; The LORD himself (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says what going out of the gate means and stresses that the LORD leads them, which the parallel lines imply (m2).

decisions.choice: "el que abre brecha ... abrirán brecha" (L, B)
decisions.reason: One Spanish expression for the Hebrew verb used twice, so that the people follow where their leader breaks through.

decisions.choice: "Đấng mở đường", capitalised
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: the breaker and the king are the LORD himself, so Vietnamese uses "Đấng", as it does for God, and the same title at every level.

decisions.choice: The king takes -시- at Balanced and Readable, since he is the LORD
decisions.reason: The breaker and the king are the LORD himself (meaning decision); Literal keeps the Hebrew's plain verbs for the king and the breaker, and every level honours the LORD named in the last line.

decisions.choice: O SENHOR em pessoa (no deity_pronoun span)
decisions.reason: The English Readable puts "himself" under the setting for pronouns for God. Portuguese says the same with "em pessoa", which is not a pronoun, so there is nothing to capitalise and no span.
